description: This file defines the StaticContentUrlProvider class which generates URL strings for static content resources based on the current HttpServletRequest context, utilizing configured prefixes and properties.

classes.name: StaticContentUrlProvider
classes.description: Provides URL strings for static content based on HttpServletRequest context and configured properties.

methods.name: StaticContentUrlProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with the current HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: pathAsContentUrlString
methods.description: Returns the full URL for a static resource given its resource path.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the URL prefix for static content, fetching it from ContentUrlTag if not already cached.
